Quiet luminance, no lava river or explosive effect. Square.

Hunter materials: raw rock, weathered timber, rope, cloth, iron and fire. STRICT LIGHT RULE: hunters' flame is amber; ALL city light is pale GREEN-WHITE, never amber or cyan-blue. Subdued deliberate palette and generous visual rest, no bloom overload. Metallurgy in material history, astronomy in restrained orbital/spiral geometry, faith in repeated care and enigmatic gestures. No written words, labels, symbols of real religions, interface, weapons or new mechanics. No humanlike gods, no extra room inventions. For close-up, material and single-prop requests frame tightly around requested subject: no vast city skyline, no large orrery, no extra characters, no extra props. The specific main subject and framing below take precedence over environmental generalities.

images.title: Door Glint — A Response Without Opening
images.detail: Close cinematic study of existing shut spiral-petal vault door. A small hunter's amber oil lamp has been set on the stone step, and its light makes one restrained reflected glint along a single worn spiral metal edge. Door remains completely sealed, no magical glow, no new socket, no opening. Dark patient mystery, square.
